purpose: Teach: 隣り/変っ/ぶらぶら/思い立っ/すかさず/たどり着く/不意/あからさま

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お隣りに新しいお店、出来たわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, did you hear? A new shop opened right next door.
lines.style: Warm observation, gentle opening. Speaking as if sharing something she noticed. Calm, conversational pace. Slight lift at the end—inviting Aoi to turn and look.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご様子が少し変ってらしたわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Some of our customers seemed a little different today, though.
lines.style: Thoughtful, noticing tone. Quiet curiosity underneath. Speaking carefully—not quite settling on what she observed. Soft fadeout, leaving room for Mei to respond.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お休みの日、商店街をぶらぶらしましょうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should take a walk through the arcade on your next day off, don't you think?
lines.style: Tender invitation, slight enthusiasm. Not demanding—more like suggesting something she'd enjoy sharing. Warm and present. Slight tilt toward hope at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、急に思い立ってお見えになったみたい、メイちゃん
lines.en: Customers have been coming in kind of suddenly lately, it seems.
lines.style: Musing observation, gentle recognition. Speaking without alarm—just noticing a pattern. Measured pace. Soft, as if thinking out loud to someone she trusts.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、すかさずお水をお出しした方が良いわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Maybe we should have water ready for them right away.
lines.style: Practical suggestion wrapped in care. Not commanding—offering what seems right. Quiet confidence. The tone of someone who thinks about what people need before they ask.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ようやくお店にたどり着くまで大変だったって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Getting here seemed to take a lot out of that customer today.
lines.style: Gentle recognition of effort unseen. Quiet compassion. Noticing without pushing. Slow, tender pace—someone who sees the tired in others and holds space for it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、不意のお祝いに皆さん喜ばれたわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Everyone seemed so pleased about the surprise celebration.
lines.style: Warmth with quiet satisfaction. Speaking like she witnessed something good unfold. Soft, content. No need to overstate—the pleasure is already there.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お喜びがあからさまにお顔に出てらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer's joy was written all over their face.
lines.style: Gentle delight in what she witnessed. Tender, genuine smile in the voice. Unhurried, savoring the observation. Slight warmth on the closing—she's still holding that moment.
